directions.observed: Raised-chin up pose with the long neck and angular snout aimed predominantly toward the top edge.
directions.reason: The jaw underside is exposed, the chin is lifted, and the original aqua eye remains present; this is unmistakably the up cardinal.
directions.horizontal_evidence: The face remains on the canonical oblique side of the body without turning into either horizontal cardinal.
directions.vertical_evidence: Nose tip, eye, and chin are stacked above the neck base, with the snout axis rising steeply toward the top edge.
directions.coordinate_evidence: In screen coordinates the nose tip is far above the shoulder and torso center; the feet and hips remain at the bottom anchor.

directions.observed: Steep raised head with a small screen-right advance from 000.
directions.reason: The snout preserves the raised-jaw family while advancing rightward as the first clockwise intermediate.
directions.horizontal_evidence: The nose tip and visible aqua eye sit to the screen-right of the neck centerline.
directions.vertical_evidence: The nose and eye remain well above the shoulder and wing root.
directions.coordinate_evidence: The head endpoint moves right from 000 while remaining near the top of the cell; torso, feet, and tail base do not move.

directions.reason: Both axes are visible: the long snout rises and projects right without losing the canonical face.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose tip is clearly screen-right of the eye socket and neck axis.
directions.vertical_evidence: Nose tip and eye remain clearly above the shoulder line.
directions.coordinate_evidence: The face occupies the upper-right sector relative to the fixed chest and hip anchor.

directions.observed: Shallow up-right pose approaching the right cardinal.
directions.reason: The snout projects strongly right but remains visibly elevated before the horizontal 090 pose.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose tip extends far to screen-right of the neck and torso center.
directions.vertical_evidence: Eye and nose remain above the shoulder, with the chin still raised.
directions.coordinate_evidence: The head endpoint is upper-right of the fixed wing root; lower-body anchors match the preceding cells.

directions.observed: Clear screen-right profile with a nearly horizontal snout.
directions.reason: The nose and eye lead toward the right edge while the neck settles from the raised family; this is unmistakably the right cardinal.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose tip is the rightmost facial landmark, distinctly right of the eye, jaw hinge, and neck center.
directions.vertical_evidence: The snout axis is approximately level rather than reading up or down.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Head extends from the torso toward the screen-right edge; hips, near and far feet, wing roots, and tail base retain their resting coordinates.

directions.observed: Right-leading face with the snout beginning to dip.
directions.reason: The pose advances clockwise from 090 with a readable downward pitch and no horizontal reversal.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose tip and aqua eye remain screen-right of the neck center.
directions.vertical_evidence: Nose tip drops below the eye and below the 090 snout line.
directions.coordinate_evidence: The face endpoint is lower-right relative to the fixed chest and wing root.

directions.reason: The head is visibly bowed toward the right lower quadrant while the canonical angular face and eye remain readable.
directions.horizontal_evidence: The muzzle projects right of the neck and chest centerline.
directions.vertical_evidence: Nose tip is below the eye and approaches the upper chest level.
directions.coordinate_evidence: The head endpoint occupies the lower-right sector relative to the shoulder; feet and tail anchors remain fixed.

directions.observed: Steep down-right pose immediately before the down cardinal.
directions.reason: The face bows strongly downward while retaining a smaller rightward component, providing a coherent approach to 180.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose tip remains slightly screen-right of the neck base and chest axis.
directions.vertical_evidence: Nose and eye are lowered toward the chest, with the snout axis steeply descending.
directions.coordinate_evidence: The face is below-right of the wing root while the oblique resting body stays registered.

directions.observed: Original bowed-face family with the snout aimed down toward the chest.
directions.reason: The bowed head is unmistakably down; partial iris occlusion is natural to the eyelid and skull angle, and the original face remains present.
directions.horizontal_evidence: The nose settles near the chest axis instead of leading toward either screen edge.
directions.vertical_evidence: Nose tip lies below the aqua eye and the skull slopes down toward the forelimbs.
directions.coordinate_evidence: The face endpoint is directly above the anchored forefeet and below the crest root; torso and tail retain the resting coordinates.

directions.observed: Bowed head begins moving to screen-left from 180.
directions.reason: The face remains down while the nose advances left as the first member of the left-turn family.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose tip shifts screen-left of the 180 chest axis and precedes the eye in that direction.
directions.vertical_evidence: The snout remains steeply lowered and the eye stays above the nose.
directions.coordinate_evidence: The head endpoint is lower-left relative to the neck base; hips, both feet sets, wing roots, and tail anchor match 180.

directions.reason: The angular snout occupies the down-left quadrant with a continuous head-neck turn and no body pivot.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose tip and eye move further screen-left of the neck center.
directions.vertical_evidence: Nose remains below the eye and below the wing-root height.
directions.coordinate_evidence: The face occupies the lower-left sector while the resting torso silhouette and tail loop remain fixed.

directions.observed: Shallow down-left pose approaching the left cardinal.
directions.reason: The leftward component dominates while the snout is still visibly below horizontal, giving a correct clockwise approach to 270.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose tip projects clearly screen-left of eye, neck, and torso center.
directions.vertical_evidence: Nose remains slightly below the eye and shoulder-level line.
directions.coordinate_evidence: The head endpoint is left and below the neck base; feet, hips, wing roots, and tail contact points are unchanged.

directions.observed: Clear screen-left profile with the angular snout nearly horizontal.
directions.reason: The nose and aqua eye lead unmistakably toward the left edge while the oblique resting body stays fixed; this is the left cardinal, not a front-facing body pivot.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose tip is the leftmost facial landmark, left of the eye, jaw hinge, and neck center; crest spines trail to the right.
directions.vertical_evidence: The snout axis is approximately level rather than reading up or down.
directions.coordinate_evidence: Only head and neck extend toward screen-left; torso, hips, near and far feet, wing roots, and tail anchors remain in the row-10 resting coordinates.

directions.observed: Left-leading face with a visible upward lift.
directions.reason: The pose advances clockwise from 270 by raising the chin and eye while retaining the leftward head family.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose tip remains screen-left of the eye and neck center.
directions.vertical_evidence: Nose and eye rise above the 270 snout line and shoulder level.
directions.coordinate_evidence: The head endpoint is upper-left of the wing root while all lower-body and tail anchors remain fixed.

directions.observed: Balanced diagonal up-left head and neck lift.
directions.reason: Both required axes are strong, with the original aqua eye and angular snout retained and no whole-body rotation.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose tip and eye remain screen-left of the neck center.
directions.vertical_evidence: Raised chin and exposed jaw underside place the nose well above the shoulder.
directions.coordinate_evidence: The face occupies the upper-left sector relative to the fixed chest, hips, feet, wing root, and tail base.

directions.observed: Steep up-left pose immediately before the up cardinal.
directions.reason: The head is strongly raised with a remaining leftward component, completing the left-family arc without reversal before 000.
directions.horizontal_evidence: Nose tip remains modestly screen-left of the neck axis and follows the 315 left-facing family.
directions.vertical_evidence: Nose and aqua eye are high above the shoulder, with the jaw underside prominently exposed.
directions.coordinate_evidence: The head endpoint is upper-left of the anchored torso; feet, hips, wing roots, and tail loop match the rest of row 10.
